Name: GAME_INFO_PARAM
Description: Entries listed in a menu, each with title and body text, a price, a sort order and an ID that controls availability.

Fields.Name: Title Message ID
Fields.Description: The ID of the text to use for the title text.

Fields.Name: Body Message ID
Fields.Description: The ID of the text to use for the body text.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: The ordering ID used to sort this in the menu.

Fields.Name: Availability Event ID
Fields.Description: The event flag ID that determines the sales status.
